note:
Write assets/layout.json: an ordered, gap-free description of every data-bank byte.

Region types:  bpe   decoded asset re-compressed at build time (tools/bpe_gage.py)
               fill  repeated byte (padding)  - generated from the layout alone
               raw   bytes not yet decoded; copied from the user's ROM at build time
Only offsets, sizes and hashes are stored - no ROM data.

regions.name: world_picture_ptrs
regions.evidence: load_world_picture (4000:1D3E mov bp,[word es:bx+0x0], ES=2000h with port C2h=F0h = ROM bank 0, index world-1) passes the word to bpe_expand; the 6 words are the 6 gallery_picture BPE streams of bank 0; the table ends at the first stream (0000C). Runtime: 12 of 12 bytes read.

regions.name: world_bg_palettes
regions.evidence: load_world_picture (4000:1D58 mov si,[es:bx+0x5a48], index = world 0-7 masked to 3 bits; 1D5D-1D79 reads words +2..+0Ah and writes them to BG palette ports 22h-2Ah) with ROM bank 0 at 2000h. 7 index words (first points 0Eh past the table start), 6 records of 16 bytes ending at the FFh padding (05AB6). Words +0, +0Ch, +0Eh of each record are not loaded by the code (palettes 0, 6, 7). Runtime: 72 of 110 bytes read.

regions.name: pause_window_ptrs
regions.evidence: pause_load_window_gfx (4000:10D1 mov bp,[word es:bx+0x0], bx = 0 vertical / 2 horizontal, ROM bank 1 via port C2h=F1h) -> bpe_expand; values = pause_window BPE streams 103E9 and 10004; the table ends at the first stream. Runtime: 4 of 4 bytes read.

regions.name: hint_sign_ptrs
regions.evidence: pause_load_window_gfx (4000:10C4 mov bp,[es:bx+0x829], bx = 2*([13FDh]+1) for hint signs, 0/2 for the 5-item window; bank 1) -> bpe_expand. 34 words: 2 pause_window streams + the 32 hint_sign streams 12BF6-1C056; ends where the menu-label table at 2000:086D begins. Runtime: 10 of 68 bytes read.

regions.name: menu_label_ptrs
regions.evidence: pause_load_item_label (4000:1123 mov bp,[es:di+0x86d], di = 2*item + 0Ah in vertical mode; bank 1) -> bpe_expand. 10 words = the 10 menu_label streams (5 horizontal, 5 vertical); ends at the first stream (10881). Runtime: 12 of 20 bytes read.

regions.name: keyconfig_panel_ptrs
regions.evidence: keyconfig_load_panels (4000:0DE6/0DF4/0E05/0E13 mov bp,[es:bx+0x1399/0x13A5/0x13A1/0x139D], bx = 0 horizontal / 2 vertical; bank 1) -> bpe_expand into tile RAM 34C0h/3A10h; values = keyconfig_panel and yes_no_button streams; ends at the first stream (113A9). Runtime: 16 of 16 bytes read.

regions.name: title_7106
regions.evidence: screen layout 7106h: far pointer 2000:0000 at 9000:01C8 (level_lookup_bg_data, ids >= 7100h index 9000:01B4 + (id-7101h)*4); loaded by title_screen_load_gfx (4000:F28E) -> load_screen_layout(DX=7106h, AL=0 tile slot, AH=0 no palette) -> level_draw_scr1_full; header parsed by bg_set_ptrs_raw (4000:4793): 3Dh tiles at +8 (copied by level_draw_scr1_full rep movsw [bx]*8 words), 19h metatiles, 1 block, palettes at [12FEh]=+738h (structurally present; not loaded for 7106h since AH=0). Runtime: bg_set_ptrs_raw, level_draw_scr1_full, bg_fetch_tile_row (title_idle run)

regions.name: title_7107
regions.evidence: screen layout 7107h: far pointer 2000:0748 at 9000:01CC; title_screen_load_gfx -> load_screen_layout(DX=7107h, AL=3Dh tile slot = right after 7106h's 3Dh tiles, AH=1) -> bg_set_ptrs_raw / level_draw_scr1_full: E0h tiles, 15h metatiles, 1 block, then 8 palette words loaded by load_bg_palettes from [12FEh] (2:1830). Runtime: bg_set_ptrs_raw, level_draw_scr1_full, bg_fetch_tile_row, load_bg_palettes

regions.name: horizontal
regions.evidence: player animation frames, horizontal orientation: player_upload_anim_frame (4000:5DA6) copies 80h words from 2000:[8000:[139Ah]*2]+[139Ch] to tile RAM 3F00h; animation ids 00h-17h (obj01_player_anim_select_normal/_carrying, frame = n*100h) have bases 1840h-6940h in the word table at 8000:0000, highest frame used ends at 6D40h; 2:1840 is also copied by load_player_base_tiles (4000:4EB4) and 2:2440 by load_player_alt_frame (4000:4EE6). 85 frames x 16 tiles drawn 4x4 row-major by obj01_player_draw_sprites_horiz (tiles 1F0h-1FFh). Runtime: player_upload_anim_frame, load_player_base_tiles. Some frames of the range are never selected by the anim code (see docs)

regions.name: vertical
regions.evidence: player animation frames, vertical orientation (ids 20h-37h = normal ids + 20h when play_flags bit0): bases 6D40h-BE40h in the table at 8000:0040, highest used frame ends at C240h where the dialogue scripts begin (4000:BB84 entry C240h); copied by player_upload_anim_frame (4000:5DA6); drawn 4x4 row-major by obj01_player_draw_sprites_vert. Runtime: player_upload_anim_frame

regions.name: scripts
regions.evidence: 15 dialogue scripts at 2000:C240-D95E: 14 from the word table 4000:BB84 (spawn_dialogue_box 4000:BBD4: [obj+18h] = cs:[BB84h+AX*2]); read by obj3d_update_text_window (4000:BD8C, ES=2000h); codes F0h-FFh dispatched through tbl_BD6C; every script ends with FFh (obj3d_text_end) and the next one starts right after it (one unreferenced script at C508h-C6A9h, between table entries 0 and 11); the last ends at D95Eh, followed by the prompt tiles at D95Fh. Runtime: obj3d_update_text_window

regions.name: prompt_cursor
regions.evidence: spawn_dialogue_box (4000:BC1A) copies 8 tiles from 2000:D95F to tile RAM 3980h (tiles 198h-19Fh) via copy_tiles_to_ram; obj3d_draw_text_window shows tile 198h + ((frame>>3)&7) while waiting on code F2h (8-step blinking prompt). Runtime: copy_tiles_to_ram

regions.name: dialogue_glyphs
regions.evidence: dialogue glyphs: text_put_glyph (4000:BEEE) copies 16 bytes from 2000:D9DF + AX*16, AX = script byte (< F0h) or code F3h label glyphs (table 4000:BBA0: B0h..D4h, +0..3); the 8-bit glyph index addresses exactly D9DFh-E9DEh, ending where the font starts. Glyphs 00h-D7h are used (scripts use 00h-AFh, labels B0h-D7h); D8h-FFh are blank (zero). Runtime: text_put_glyph (Japanese-ROM runs)

regions.name: font_ascii
regions.evidence: font: load_font_tiles (4000:B720) copies 400h words from 2000:E9DF to tile RAM 34B0h (ASCII 20h -> tile 14Bh); only the first 64 tiles (ASCII 20h-5Fh) are font data: the copy continues over the story sequencer table (2:EDDF) and FFh padding. End bound = start of the story table

regions.name: sequencer_table
regions.evidence: state09_story_sequencer (4000:1AE4): ES=2000h, loop CX=0Fh over records of 6 bytes at [es:bx-1221h] = 2000:EDDF: key compared with progress_code, +2 -> [13C0h] (script number passed to spawn_dialogue_box), +4 -> game_state (docs/game-states.md). Followed by FFh padding at 2:EE39
